(photo of a camera and a video camera on a beach); on 2023-08-22, told Dave he scored a deal to continue collaborating with Frank Ocean ("a dream come true" — he met Frank at a Tokyo music festival and they clicked, and they recorded a song in Calvin's mansion studio; of the festival: the city was "buzzing with energy" and the crowd "like fuel for my soul"; later on 2023-08-22: said someone noticed his performance and now they're working together, that his tour ends soon and he's heading to Boston where he proposed meeting Dave, and that on 2023-08-21 he recorded a podcast with his friends about the "rapidly evolving rap industry" (will let Dave know when it uploads)), and on 2023-08-14, his tour with a well-known artist ended with a show in Tokyo ("awesome": the crowd sang along to his song, a "magical moment"; shared a photo of a concert crowd with hands up — these moments are why he loves his job; the show was "buzzing", these moments are "what make me so proud and motivated", and he's "all about spreading joy with my art"), and he got to explore his new place in Japan ("like a dream come true"); also on 2023-08-14, the chat with Dave turned to Dave's car restoration (photo of a car with a broken engine in the woods; Calvin: "going to look amazing", asked how long it would take) and closed with Calvin cheering Dave on ("You got this, Dave! I'm always here for you... Keep growing, buddy. See ya!"); as of 2023-08-03, revealed his red luxury sports car is a Ferrari and said its recent service was very stressful (he's attached to it; at the Ferrari dealership he saw lots of amazing cars but his is the best — "it reminds me of my hard work and dedication"; photo of the red car on a lift in a garage); on 2023-07-21, is transforming his Japanese mansion into a recording studio (his dream of a space for creating music with other artists, his "sanctuary" that reminds him why he loves music; shared a progress photo), and experimenting with new genres — adding electronic elements to his songs for a "fresh vibe", finding the balance between sticking to his sound and trying new stuff "intimidating" but motivating; says he started making music to follow his dreams, is "stoked" about how far he's come, and that collaborating with others, learning from them, and surrounding himself with positive energy and passion keep him motivated under the pressure; as of 2023-07-07 the car is fixed and going strong after the 2023-06-16 accident ("Nothing better than cruising around"; photo of the red sports car parked on the side of the road), and he revealed he's living in a Japanese mansion with an "epic" cityscape ("like a dream come true"; backyard photo of a boat docked in a canal at sunset; photo of the mansion front with lots of windows and lights); on 2023-06-21: car accident on 2023-06-16 (red sports car on a sidewalk, no one hurt): insurance was a slow, paperwork-heavy hassle but sorted in a week and cost "wasn't too bad"; car at an auto repair shop with a skilled mechanic; earlier (2023-06-09): met with the creative team for his album on 2023-06-08, "stoked" and "everything coming together"; explicitly never been to Boston and can't wait to visit in July 2023 (heard the parks are amazing); on 2023-06-09 also shared a photo of a plane flying over snowy mountains — has never been to the mountains but is keen to go on a hike there to "escape it all and de-stress"; earlier (2023-05-31): touring with Frank Ocean the week before (~2023-05-22/28), Tokyo stop "unreal" (insane crowd, felt alive performing), Boston a tour stop ("Gonna be great playing for folks from home"); performing live "always fuels my soul" — "an absolute high"; finds working on/fixing cars relaxing, like meditation; earlier: home music studio, saved gear from a home flood, new mansion ("new mansion"), a red luxury sports car, Tokyo music festival (April 2023), and a world-tour dream. As of 2023-06-21 also has a small town in Japan with an "unbelievably stunning" mountain view on his to-do list to visit after the Frank Ocean tour ends; on the same day, said he has never tried skiing but it looks like "a lot of fun" and he might try it once. As of 2023-07-07, is working on music collaborations with Japanese artists (promised Dave clips when ready) and looking forward to trying the Japanese food and checking out the culture. Also on 2023-08-03: his plan for now is to expand his brand worldwide and grow his fanbase (music reaching more people, making an impact; goals too: working with artists from around the globe, challenging himself to create special music); shared a photo of performing with his band "the boys" on 2023-08-02 ("they are great at the music"); and says seeing his Ferrari everyday keeps him motivated and reminds him to keep pushing. On 2023-08-11, praised Dave's attention to detail on the car mod project and — being busy with his own music — kept Dave's offer of a hand at Dave's music studio in mind; the conversation ended with Dave wishing him good luck with his music and the two exchanging goodbyes.
/memories/calvin.md:L55: - On 2023-08-31, when Dave asked how the end of the tour was, Calvin said the tour was amazing — he was "so pumped from all the energy from the audience" — and shared a photo of a crowd watching a concert with a large screen ("This pic totally captures how I felt. Such an amazing time!"); when Dave asked how it was performing on that big stage, Calvin said it was "a dream come true" — the energy was incredible, he "felt on top of the world", and it was "seriously surreal" [S16T2][S16T3][S16T4].
/memories/calvin.md:L113: ## Music video (Miami, 2023-08-31)
/memories/calvin.md:L114: - On 2023-08-31, told Dave that last weekend (~2023-08-25/26) he started shooting a video for his new album (the album in progress since 2023-06-09, see ## Music) — "can't wait for you to check it out!" — and shared a photo of a camera and a video camera on a beach ("Look how great it was!"); Dave: "Can't wait to see it", and asked whether it will be shot on location [S16T6][S16T7].
/memories/calvin.md:L115: - The shoot is in Miami, on an awesome beach — "It's going to have some epic visuals!" [S16T8].

as of 2023-08-22, reconnected with Calvin: shared his card night with friends on 2023-08-18 ("so much fun"; photo of men around a table with playing cards) and congratulated Calvin on scoring a deal to continue collaborating with Frank Ocean, and later on 2023-08-22 asked about other collaborations and upcoming concerts, agreed to meet up when Calvin's tour ends and he heads to Boston, and looked forward to the podcast Calvin recorded with friends on 2023-08-21 about the rap industry, and on 2023-08-14, attended a car workshop in San Francisco (dove into car restoration and the different techniques; people there "really passionate and dedicated" — "truly inspiring"), and updated Calvin that his car restoration is "going great" (photo of the car — a car with a broken engine in the woods — going "from a beat-up mess to a real beauty"; hopes to have it all fixed up by the end of September 2023), and the chat closed with Calvin cheering him on ("You got this, Dave!"); as of 2023-08-11, was picked for a car mod workshop (a dream come true — he's always wanted to learn auto engineering and work on building a custom car); on his current car he's doing engine swaps and suspension modifications and is learning body mods, giving a classic muscle car a "modern twist" (photo of a silver Corvette); in the same chat he said the goal was "a modern vibe but also that classic muscle car style" — the small details make it "unique and personalized", "like customizing a work of art on wheels" — and he's "really happy with it"; he also has a music studio setup with a high-quality sound system and offered Calvin a hand with his music (Calvin: busy but will keep it in mind); as of 2023-08-03, told Calvin fixing cars is like therapy for him: growing up working on cars with his dad, refurbishing them gives a sense of fulfillment; fond childhood memories — one summer he and his dad restored an old car together ("knowing that we did it together was really satisfying"), shared a photo from that time (a man and a child posing); on 2023-07-21, just back from a road trip with friends through stunning countryside (a break from the "corporate mayhem"; winding roads, views and chatting "recharged" him and reminded him why he loves cars; shared a photo of a person riding a motorcycle down a dirt road — "a wonderful place" they found; says reconnecting with his passion makes the long hours at work worth it), and in his 2023-07-21 chat with Calvin encouraged him to keep collaborating and staying surrounded by good vibes, telling him "keep going, buddy!" and calling himself Calvin's "biggest fan"; on 2023-07-07 has arranged regular walks with friends at a favorite park spot: a city skyline with a river and boats (photo shared, "today we are going to that spot"), and confirmed Calvin's car is fixed after the crash; on 2023-06-21: sympathized with Calvin's car accident (2023-06-16) and asked about the insurance process and the mechanic; earlier (2023-06-09): explores parks on weekends to relax ("so peaceful being surrounded by nature"; weekend walks "recharge [him] for the entire upcoming week"); calls Boston parks "awesome, especially in spring" (walked one 2023-06-02); hasn't hiked recently but finds hiking "clears your mind and brings a sense of calm"; booked a trip to a mountainous region for July 2023 ("finally gonna be able to see those majestic peaks") and promised Calvin lots of pics when he gets back; car maintenance shop (opened ~2023-05-08/14, teaming up with a local garage), recently fixed a neighbor's car engine himself; working on cars "definitely therapeutic", fixing things gives purpose, "like giving it a second chance"; obsessed with classic cars (restored one in 2022), dreams of building a custom car from scratch; music lover (favorite band Aerosmith; creative-block tip: immerse in concerts and favorite albums); apparently based in Boston, plans to show Calvin around and will be at Calvin's Boston show; after seeing Calvin's Tokyo skyline photo wants to visit Tokyo himself. On 2023-06-21 also cheered Calvin on trusting the repair shop, marveled at Calvin's photo of a small town in Japan with mountains, and asked whether Calvin has tried skiing; also announced he recently joined a rock band and is practicing guitar (shared a photo of the band), and he says good company and great music lift the mood and bring positive emotions. As of 2023-07-07, has never been to Japan but is "so keen to go one day" (heard it's full of vibes, good eats and awesome tech) and is "hooked on" Japanese music. Also on 2023-08-03, asked Calvin about his biggest goal, encouraged him to "keep it up and keep making a difference", and closed by urging him to "keep at it and never forget your dreams" and "You've got this!". On 2023-08-11, ended the chat by wishing Calvin good luck with his music and the two exchanged goodbyes.

/memories/calvin.md (71976 bytes) [description: Calvin's life updates as of 2023-10-04 — on 2023-10-04, caught up with Dave: told him the day before (2023-10-03) he met "incredible" artists in Boston and talked about working together — arranged through a mutual friend who "knew we'd be a great fit" — and is "stoked to collaborate with them on new music" (each has an individual style; "Can't wait to show you the final result"); when Dave asked what he works on to relax, Calvin said he loves working on a car project "to chill out" and shared a photo of a shiny orange car with its hood open, and Dave said working on cars is "therapeutic to see them come back to life," revealing the restoration car is a Ford Mustang he found in a junkyard ("in bad shape, but I knew it had potential") and sharing photos (a red car parked in a field with other cars; their grease-stained hands after a day in the garage), and the chat closed with mutual encouragement about progress, hard work, dedication, and determination (Dave: "it's the small successes that make me feel proud and fulfilled") and final goodbyes (Calvin: "Wishing you all the best until we meet again!"; Dave: "We got this! Take care and stay well!"); on 2023-09-22, caught up with Dave: sympathized with Dave's vintage Mustang engine trouble (a weird noise on startup after Dave thought he'd fixed it — photo of a car engine with a small engine), and shared a photo of his red sports car (Ferrari) parked in a parking lot as "a sign of my hard work and dedication" — "Looking at it reminds me how far I've come"; when Dave asked whether he has any special memories with the car, Calvin recalled an unforgettable summer drive ("the wind blowing through my hair and the rush of freedom") and said his trip to Japan was incredible — "the culture, the people, everything was so cool," "I'm already longing to go back, it was an experience that made all the hard work worth it"; when Dave asked whether any song from his childhood brings back memories, Calvin said one song "always makes me smile" — it played during a road trip with his dad, and they sang along to it — and identified it: a song by Tupac and Dr. Dre, "California Love" ("Ah, those were the days!"); Dave called it a classic and invited Calvin to jam some music together, and Calvin agreed, and the chat closed with mutual "see ya soon" goodbyes; on 2023-09-15, caught up with Dave: reacted to Dave's band jam the night before (2023-09-14 — "the music just kept flowing") ("When everything just clicks during a jam session, it's such a great feeling.") and to Dave's Boston rock concert last weekend (~2023-09-09/10, "an amazing atmosphere"), and said "Rock concerts always have such an electrifying atmosphere!"; the jam wasn't recorded, and Calvin said "Aww, bummer! I would've loved to hear that music," but "some of the best memories can't be captured on video or audio" — "those special moments that stay in our hearts and minds"; Calvin shared a Ratatouille Disney poster (a Disney movie poster with a chef) — Ratatouille is one of his favorites, "It's all about going after what you love, no matter what anyone says" — which reminded Dave of one of his favorite Disney movies ("the lesson ... about following your dreams no matter what others say"); Calvin then asked how Dave's car hobby was going, and Dave: "It's been awesome," "Been restoring this vintage beauty," sharing the "final result" photo (a man standing next to a classic car), implying the restoration is finished ahead of his earlier end-of-September-2023 hope; Calvin: "Nice work, Dave! That looks amazing. Is it satisfying to see your hard work pay off?" — Dave: "It's so satisfying to see this brought back to life," especially seeing people's reactions to the finished product, "makes all the hard work worth it"; Calvin: "it's awesome seeing people happy thanks to you! Fixing cars is such an art. You're inspiring - keep up the good work!", and the conversation closed with Calvin: "You're really talented, Dave. Keep making people happy and doing what you love. That's what it's all about. See you soon, have a nice one!"; on 2023-09-13, told Dave his album finally dropped on 2023-09-11 ("a wild feeling"; everyone's been loving it, "kinda overwhelming" but motivating him to make even better music; positive feedback gives him strength — "My journey's just getting started!"), and that next up is a tour ("so excited!") after which he's off to explore and grow his brand (Dave asked for tour cities/venues — unanswered); Calvin then got excited about the tour stops ("We're hitting some awesome spots - it's gonna be epic!"), Dave said live music is the best and offered to show Calvin around his garage and its cool cars (shared a photo of the garage — a car in a garage with a Coca-Cola sign — "looks stunning!"), and Calvin accepted the garage-tour offer (hoping for ideas for future projects) and re-pledged to let Dave know when he's in Boston, and the chat closed with mutual goodbyes; on 2023-09-02, reconnected with Dave ("Hey Calvin! Been a while, what's up?"): said Dave must feel great making a real difference in someone's life — "like being their superhero!" — and that he should be proud of bringing joy to others, then told Dave he booked a flight to Boston last week (~2023-08-26 through 09-01) and is "so excited" about the upcoming trip, sharing a photo of a book with a boarding pass on it; he'll let Dave know when he's in Boston, and Dave told him to let him know when he's free so they can catch up in Boston (see the Boston trip section); the chat closed with mutual goodbyes and Calvin promising to contact Dave when he arrives; on 2023-08-31, told Dave the tour was amazing ("so pumped from all the energy from the audience"; performing on the big stage was "a dream come true" — he "felt on top of the world" and it was "seriously surreal"; photo of a crowd watching a concert with a large screen), and that he started shooting a video for his new album last weekend (~2023-08-25/26) — the shoot is in Miami on an awesome beach, "It's going to have some epic visuals!" (photo of a camera and a video camera on a beach); the chat also ended with Dave complimenting Calvin's custom octopus guitar (made by his Japanese artist friend; one of Calvin's favorites, a reminder of his passion for music and friendships; photo of a guitar with an octopus on it; custom shiny purple finish he chose because it's unique and goes with his style, and Calvin — who values staying true to himself and being unique in his music — glad Dave appreciates it); Dave then affirmed that staying true to yourself and your style is vital and makes Calvin unique and his music stand out ("Keep it real, bud. You've got something great to give the world.") and Dave offering to help with props for the video; on 2023-08-22, told Dave he scored a deal to continue collaborating with Frank Ocean ("a dream come true" — he met Frank at a Tokyo music festival and they clicked, and they recorded a song in Calvin's mansion studio; of the festival: the city was "buzzing with energy" and the crowd "like fuel for my soul"; later on 2023-08-22: said someone noticed his performance and now they're working together, that his tour ends soon and he's heading to Boston where he proposed meeting Dave, and that on 2023-08-21 he recorded a podcast with his friends about the "rapidly evolving rap industry" (will let Dave know when it uploads)), and on 2023-08-14, his tour with a well-known artist ended with a show in Tokyo ("awesome": the crowd sang along to his song, a "magical moment"; shared a photo of a concert crowd with hands up — these moments are why he loves his job; the show was "buzzing", these moments are "what make me so proud and motivated", and he's "all about spreading joy with my art"), and he got to explore his new place in Japan ("like a dream come true"); also on 2023-08-14, the chat with Dave turned to Dave's car restoration (photo of a car with a broken engine in the woods; Calvin: "going to look amazing", asked how long it would take) and closed with Calvin cheering Dave on ("You got this, Dave! I'm always here for you... Keep growing, buddy. See ya!"); as of 2023-08-03, revealed his red luxury sports car is a Ferrari and said its recent service was very stressful (he's attached to it; at the Ferrari dealership he saw lots of amazing cars but his is the best — "it reminds me of my hard work and dedication"; photo of the red car on a lift in a garage); on 2023-07-21, is transforming his Japanese mansion into a recording studio (his dream of a space for creating music with other artists, his "sanctuary" that reminds him why he loves music; shared a progress photo), and experimenting with new genres — adding electronic elements to his songs for a "fresh vibe", finding the balance between sticking to his sound and trying new stuff "intimidating" but motivating; says he started making music to follow his dreams, is "stoked" about how far he's come, and that collaborating with others, learning from them, and surrounding himself with positive energy and passion keep him motivated under the pressure; as of 2023-07-07 the car is fixed and going strong after the 2023-06-16 accident ("Nothing better than cruising around"; photo of the red sports car parked on the side of the road), and he revealed he's living in a Japanese mansion with an "epic" cityscape ("like a dream come true"; backyard photo of a boat docked in a canal at sunset; photo of the mansion front with lots of windows and lights); on 2023-06-21: car accident on 2023-06-16 (red sports car on a sidewalk, no one hurt): insurance was a slow, paperwork-heavy hassle but sorted in a week and cost "wasn't too bad"; car at an auto repair shop with a skilled mechanic; earlier (2023-06-09): met with the creative team for his album on 2023-06-08, "stoked" and "everything coming together"; explicitly never been to Boston and can't wait to visit in July 2023 (heard the parks are amazing); on 2023-06-09 also shared a photo of a plane flying over snowy mountains — has never been to the mountains but is keen to go on a hike there to "escape it all and de-stress"; earlier (2023-05-31): touring with Frank Ocean the week before (~2023-05-22/28), Tokyo stop "unreal" (insane crowd, felt alive performing), Boston a tour stop ("Gonna be great playing for folks from home"); performing live "always fuels my soul" — "an absolute high"; finds working on/fixing cars relaxing, like meditation; earlier: home music studio, saved gear from a home flood, new mansion ("new mansion"), a red luxury sports car, Tokyo music festival (April 2023), and a world-tour dream. As of 2023-06-21 also has a small town in Japan with an "unbelievably stunning" mountain view on his to-do list to visit after the Frank Ocean tour ends; on the same day, said he has never tried skiing but it looks like "a lot of fun" and he might try it once. As of 2023-07-07, is working on music collaborations with Japanese artists (promised Dave clips when ready) and looking forward to trying the Japanese food and checking out the culture. Also on 2023-08-03: his plan for now is to expand his brand worldwide and grow his fanbase (music reaching more people, making an impact; goals too: working with artists from around the globe, challenging himself to create special music); shared a photo of performing with his band "the boys" on 2023-08-02 ("they are great at the music"); and says seeing his Ferrari everyday keeps him motivated and reminds him to keep pushing. On 2023-08-11, praised Dave's attention to detail on the car mod project and — being busy with his own music — kept Dave's offer of a hand at Dave's music studio in mind; the conversation ended with Dave wishing him good luck with his music and the two exchanging goodbyes.]

fond childhood memories — one summer he and his dad restored an old car together ("knowing that we did it together was really satisfying"), shared a photo from that time (a man and a child posing); on 2023-07-21, just back from a road trip with friends through stunning countryside (a break from the "corporate mayhem"; winding roads, views and chatting "recharged" him and reminded him why he loves cars; shared a photo of a person riding a motorcycle down a dirt road — "a wonderful place" they found; says reconnecting with his passion makes the long hours at work worth it), and in his 2023-07-21 chat with Calvin encouraged him to keep collaborating and staying surrounded by good vibes, telling him "keep going, buddy!" and calling himself Calvin's "biggest fan"; on 2023-07-07 has arranged regular walks with friends at a favorite park spot: a city skyline with a river and boats (photo shared, "today we are going to that spot"), and confirmed Calvin's car is fixed after the crash; on 2023-06-21: sympathized with Calvin's car accident (2023-06-16) and asked about the insurance process and the mechanic; earlier (2023-06-09): explores parks on weekends to relax ("so peaceful being surrounded by nature"; weekend walks "recharge [him] for the entire upcoming week"); calls Boston parks "awesome, especially in spring" (walked one 2023-06-02); hasn't hiked recently but finds hiking "clears your mind and brings a sense of calm"; booked a trip to a mountainous region for July 2023 ("finally gonna be able to see those majestic peaks") and promised Calvin lots of pics when he gets back; car maintenance shop (opened ~2023-05-08/14, teaming up with a local garage), recently fixed a neighbor's car engine himself; working on cars "definitely therapeutic", fixing things gives purpose, "like giving it a second chance"; obsessed with classic cars (restored one in 2022), dreams of building a custom car from scratch; music lover (favorite band Aerosmith; creative-block tip: immerse in concerts and favorite albums); apparently based in Boston, plans to show Calvin around and will be at Calvin's Boston show; after seeing Calvin's Tokyo skyline photo wants to visit Tokyo himself. On 2023-06-21 also cheered Calvin on trusting the repair shop, marveled at Calvin's photo of a small town in Japan with mountains, and asked whether Calvin has tried skiing; also announced he recently joined a rock band and is practicing guitar (shared a photo of the band), and he says good company and great music lift the mood and bring positive emotions. As of 2023-07-07, has never been to Japan but is "so keen to go one day" (heard it's full of vibes, good eats and awesome tech) and is "hooked on" Japanese music. Also on 2023-08-03, asked Calvin about his biggest goal, encouraged him to "keep it up and keep making a difference", and closed by urging him to "keep at it and never forget your dreams" and "You've got this!". On 2023-08-11, ended the chat by wishing Calvin good luck with his music and the two exchanged goodbyes.]

L3: description: Calvin's life updates as of 2023-10-23 — on 2023-10-23, caught up with Dave about the Frank Ocean tour and its effect on his life (referencing their earlier chat about fame and its impact on relationships): the tour's been incredible — performing and connecting with the crowd is energizing — but fame has its own challenges and it's been tough balancing everything; he manages by taking it one day at a time (it can get overwhelming with so many demands, but he enjoys what he does and pushes on) and leans on a strong support system — friends and team keep him on track; also said staying connected and up-to-date on world events is important to him — it helps his music stand out by incorporating unique perspectives, connects him better with his fans, and keeps him motivated and inspired (Dave shared his recent good conversations with neighbors about current events and politics); on 2023-10-19, caught up with Dave: told him he started touring with Frank Ocean ("lots happened" since they last talked) — "it's been amazing" — the crowd energy is great and "such a connection when I'm on stage," and shared photos of his stage performance (a band performing on stage with bright lights), of himself and Frank Ocean on stage (a band on stage with a projection of a man on the wall), and of a large crowd in an auditorium ("Look at this crowd, that was insane!"); said the tour "has been great" and that jamming with Frank Ocean is "a dream come true," and — when Dave asked how it happened — gave a new account: it started when they met at a festival in August 2022 ("August last year") and Frank said he wanted to collaborate, "we clicked right away," and the stage chemistry is incredible; Dave: "Congrats, Calvin!", "I bet performing with him is like a dream come true!", "you and Frank are so in tune!", "Can't wait to catch your show!", and Calvin: "I'm so excited you'll be at one of our shows" and "you'll definitely enjoy it!"; later that day Calvin shared another concert-crowd photo (a crowd of people at a concert with their hands in the air) — "Wow, the crowd energy is amazing! It always gets me so pumped" — taken in Tokyo during a concert, where "the energy was nuts" — "felt like the whole city came out!"; Dave: "Everyone looks so pumped. Where was that taken?" and, shown a photo of a busy street with people walking and shopping, said Tokyo looks incredible, it's "making me dream about visiting someday" and the energy there "seems unbeatable," and asked whether Calvin had visited streets like that; Calvin: yes, visiting similar streets was "an incredible experience," and asked what else interests Dave in Tokyo; Dave: Tokyo is amazing — he wants to know "everything about it - the people, the culture, the food, take a walk at the vibrant city life!" (shared a photo of a crowded street at night, "the city is so alive and colorful that's impressive", "It will be an unforgettable experience!"); Calvin: "Can't wait to hear your emotions when you see that in person!" and Dave: "Hope I'll get to see it in person soon!"; later that day, Calvin announced he's going to Tokyo in November 2023 after the tour ends (shared a photo of a night city with a tall building — "What a great view!") — looking forward to Shibuya Crossing ("like Tokyo's Times Square"), Shinjuku, and the amazing food there (first-time ramen for him — "Gonna give it a shot while in Tokyo"); Dave: "Shibuya and Shinjuku are cool spots!" and, having tried ramen in Boston ("it was delicious, but in Tokyo it will be even better"), urged "Once you try it, you'll never go back. Bon voyage and have fun!" — and the chat closed with "See you soon, bye!"; on 2023-10-15, reconnected with Dave: Dave told him it's been "a crazy rollercoaster week" — a competing car maintenance shop snagged a deal his shop had been trying to secure for months — and he felt "kinda bummed out," questioning whether his hard work was wasted ("Am I wasting my time?"); Calvin: "It can be discouraging when you feel like your hard work goes unnoticed. But don't give up, keep pushing and believe in yourself. The payoff will be worth it."; Dave: "I gotta have faith and patience. I'm sure it's only a matter of time till things work out." and asked how Calvin stays motivated when faced with setbacks; Calvin: "When setbacks come my way, I remind myself why I'm passionate about my goals. I rely on helpful people around me and take a break to recharge with my favorite activities. That always helps me get back to feeling motivated."; Dave then told him he just got back from a music festival — "it was amazing! The energy, the music, the crowd - sooo good. I felt so alive!" — and shared a photo of the main stage (a stage with a crowd of people watching a band), "The main stage was unreal. The headliner was so good and the vibe was unreal!" — Dave then answered Calvin's question: The Fireworks headlined, and Calvin said he "heard great things" about them ("Performing with Frank Ocean recently has been really cool. That's why I love my job so much - connecting with the crowd."); after mutual encouragement about fixing/broken things and "keep pushing" / "never forget how awesome you are," Calvin closed by announcing he got a new Ferrari "last week" (~2023-10-09/15) — "a masterpiece on wheels" — sharing a photo of a black sports car parked in front of a building ("Perhaps a photo of this unique beauty will lift your mood") — Dave: "Congratulations on the new Ferrari" and asked Calvin to "share a pic of your new beauty whenever you're ready," and Calvin agreed to "share a pic soon," and the chat closed with "Here's to more thrilling rides and positive vibes" and looking forward to catching up soon; on 2023-10-08, caught up with Dave: reacted to Dave's car-show visit (last Friday, 2023-10-06) — "I'm into the rush of awesome cars" — and "Can't wait to check out your garage," sharing a photo of a red sports car parked in a showroom; called the car Dave restored and modified himself (custom exhaust + performance upgrades, "a sweet sound") a masterpiece ("Wow, Dave! You really turned it into a masterpiece. Impressive!"); said bringing broken things back to life is "so satisfying," working on cars can be "a real escape from reality," and "doing what you love for a living, that's the ultimate goal"; encouraged Dave: "Chasing your dreams is what life's about. It's awesome to see how far you've come. Keep working hard and living your best life." and pledged "I'll always be here to support you and give you that boost," closing with "No worries, Dave. Keep going for it. You got this!" (Dave: his support "means a lot", these conversations remind him why he loves what he does, and he'll keep pushing); on 2023-10-04, caught up with Dave: told him the day before (2023-10-03) he met "incredible" artists in Boston and talked about working together — arranged through a mutual friend who "knew we'd be a great fit" — and is "stoked to collaborate with them on new music" (each has an individual style; "Can't wait to show you the final result"); when Dave asked what he works on to relax, Calvin said he loves working on a car project "to chill out" and shared a photo of a shiny orange car with its hood open, and Dave said working on cars is "therapeutic to see them come back to life," revealing the restoration car is a Ford Mustang he found in a junkyard ("in bad shape, but I knew it had potential") and sharing photos (a red car parked in a field with other cars; their grease-stained hands after a day in the garage), and the chat closed with mutual encouragement about progress, hard work, dedication, and determination (Dave: "it's the small successes that make me feel proud and fulfilled") and final goodbyes (Calvin: "Wishing you all the best until we meet again!"; Dave: "We got this! Take care and stay well!"); on 2023-09-22, caught up with Dave: sympathized with Dave's vintage Mustang engine trouble (a weird noise on startup after Dave thought he'd fixed it — photo of a car engine with a small engine), and shared a photo of his red sports car (Ferrari) parked in a parking lot as "a sign of my hard work and dedication" — "Looking at it reminds me how far I've come"; when Dave asked whether he has any special memories with the car, Calvin recalled an unforgettable summer drive ("the wind blowing through my hair and the rush of freedom") and said his trip to Japan was incredible — "the culture, the people, everything was so cool," "I'm already longing to go back, it was an experience that made all the hard work worth it"; when Dave asked whether any song from his childhood brings back memories, Calvin said one song "always makes me smile" — it played during a road trip with his dad, and they sang along to it — and identified it: a song by Tupac and Dr. Dre, "California Love" ("Ah, those were the days!"); Dave called it a classic and invited Calvin to jam some music together, and Calvin agreed, and the chat closed with mutual "see ya soon" goodbyes; on 2023-09-15, caught up with Dave: reacted to Dave's band jam the night before (2023-09-14 — "the music just kept flowing") ("When everything just clicks during a jam session, it's such a great feeling.") and to Dave's Boston rock concert last weekend (~2023-09-09/10, "an amazing atmosphere"), and said "Rock concerts always have such an electrifying atmosphere!"; the jam wasn't recorded, and Calvin said "Aww, bummer! I would've loved to hear that music," but "some of the best memories can't be captured on video or audio" — "those special moments that stay in our hearts and minds"; Calvin shared a Ratatouille Disney poster (a Disney movie poster with a chef) — Ratatouille is one of his favorites, "It's all about going after what you love, no matter what anyone says" — which reminded Dave of one of his favorite Disney movies ("the lesson ... about following your dreams no matter what others say"); Calvin then asked how Dave's car hobby was going, and Dave: "It's been awesome," "Been restoring this vintage beauty," sharing the "final result" photo (a man standing next to a classic car), implying the restoration is finished ahead of his earlier end-of-September-2023 hope; Calvin: "Nice work, Dave! That looks amazing. Is it satisfying to see your hard work pay off?" — Dave: "It's so satisfying to see this brought back to life," especially seeing people's reactions to the finished product, "makes all the hard work worth it"; Calvin: "it's awesome seeing people happy thanks to you! Fixing cars is such an art. You're inspiring - keep up the good work!", and the conversation closed with Calvin: "You're really talented, Dave. Keep making people happy and doing what you love. That's what it's all about. See you soon, have a nice one!"; on 2023-09-13, told Dave his album finally dropped on 2023-09-11 ("a wild feeling"; everyone's been loving it, "kinda overwhelming" but motivating him to make even better music; positive feedback gives him strength — "My journey's just getting started!"), and that next up is a tour ("so excited!") after which he's off to explore and grow his brand (Dave asked for tour cities/venues — unanswered); Calvin then got excited about the tour stops ("We're hitting some awesome spots - it's gonna be epic!"), Dave said live music is the best and offered to show Calvin around his garage and its cool cars (shared a photo of the garage — a car in a garage with a Coca-Cola sign — "looks stunning!"), and Calvin accepted the garage-tour offer (hoping for ideas for future projects) and re-pledged to let Dave know when he's in Boston, and the chat closed with mutual goodbyes; on 2023-09-02, reconnected with Dave ("Hey Calvin! Been a while, what's up?"): said Dave must feel great making a real difference in someone's life — "like being their superhero!" — and that he should be proud of bringing joy to others, then told Dave he booked a flight to Boston last week (~2023-08-26 through 09-01) and is "so excited" about the upcoming trip, sharing a photo of a book with a boarding pass on it; he'll let Dave know when he's in Boston, and Dave told him to let him know when he's free so they can catch up in Boston (see the Boston trip section); the chat closed with mutual goodbyes and Calvin promising to contact Dave when he arrives; on 2023-08-31, told Dave the tour was amazing ("so pumped from all the energy from the audience"; performing on the big stage was "a dream come true" — he "felt on top of the world" and it was "seriously surreal"; photo of a crowd watching a concert with a large screen), and that he started shooting a video for his new album last weekend (~2023-08-25/26) — the shoot is in Miami on an awesome beach, "It's going to have some epic visuals!" (photo of a camera and a video camera on a beach); the chat also ended with Dave complimenting Calvin's custom octopus guitar (made by his Japanese artist friend; one of Calvin's favorites, a reminder of his passion for music and friendships; photo of a guitar with an octopus on it; custom shiny purple finish he chose because it's unique and goes with his style, and Calvin — who values staying true to himself and being unique in his music — glad Dave appreciates it); Dave then affirmed that staying true to yourself and your style is vital and makes Calvin unique and his music stand out ("Keep it real, bud. You've got something great to give the world.") and Dave offering to help with props for the video; on 2023-08-22, told Dave he scored a deal to continue collaborating with Frank Ocean ("a dream come true" — he met Frank at a Tokyo music festival and they clicked, and they recorded a song in Calvin's mansion studio; of the festival: the city was "buzzing with energy" and the crowd "like fuel for my soul"; later on 2023-08-22: said someone noticed his performance and now they're working together, that his tour ends soon and he's heading to Boston where he proposed meeting Dave, and that on 2023-08-21 he recorded a podcast with his friends about the "rapidly evolving rap industry" (will let Dave know when it uploads)), and on 2023-08-14, his tour with a well-known artist ended with a show in Tokyo ("awesome": the crowd sang along to his song, a "magical moment"; shared a photo of a concert crowd with hands up — these moments are why he loves his job; the show was "buzzing", these moments are "what make me so proud and motivated", and he's "all about spreading joy with my art"), and he got to explore his new place in Japan ("like a dream come true"); also on 2023-08-14, the chat with Dave turned to Dave's car restoration (photo of a car with a broken engine in the woods; Calvin: "going to look amazing", asked how long it would take) and closed with Calvin cheering Dave on ("You got this, Dave! I'm always here for you... Keep growing, buddy. See ya!"); as of 2023-08-03, revealed his red luxury sports car is a Ferrari and said its recent service was very stressful (he's attached to it; at the Ferrari dealership he saw lots of amazing cars but his is the best — "it reminds me of my hard work and dedication"; photo of the red car on a lift in a garage); on 2023-07-21, is transforming his Japanese mansion into a recording studio (his dream of a space for creating music with other artists, his "sanctuary" that reminds him why he loves music; shared a progress photo), and experimenting with new genres — adding electronic elements to his songs for a "fresh vibe", finding the balance between sticking to his sound and trying new stuff "intimidating" but motivating; says he started making music to follow his dreams, is "stoked" about how far he's come, and that collaborating with others, learning from them, and surrounding himself with positive energy and passion keep him motivated under the pressure; as of 2023-07-07 the car is fixed and going strong after the 2023-06-16 accident ("Nothing better than cruising around"; photo of the red sports car parked on the side of the road), and he revealed he's living in a Japanese mansion with an "epic" cityscape ("like a dream come true"; backyard photo of a boat docked in a canal at sunset; photo of the mansion front with lots of windows and lights); on 2023-06-21: car accident on 2023-06-16 (red sports car on a sidewalk, no one hurt): insurance was a slow, paperwork-heavy hassle but sorted in a week and cost "wasn't too bad"; car at an auto repair shop with a skilled mechanic; earlier (2023-06-09): met with the creative team for his album on 2023-06-08, "stoked" and "everything coming together"; explicitly never been to Boston and can't wait to visit in July 2023 (heard the parks are amazing); on 2023-06-09 also shared a photo of a plane flying over snowy mountains — has never been to the mountains but is keen to go on a hike there to "escape it all and de-stress"; earlier (2023-05-31): touring with Frank Ocean the week before (~2023-05-22/28), Tokyo stop "unreal" (insane crowd, felt alive performing), Boston a tour stop ("Gonna be great playing for folks from home"); performing live "always fuels my soul" — "an absolute high"; finds working on/fixing cars relaxing, like meditation; earlier: home music studio, saved gear from a home flood, new mansion ("new mansion"), a red luxury sports car, Tokyo music festival (April 2023), and a world-tour dream. As of 2023-06-21 also has a small town in Japan with an "unbelievably stunning" mountain view on his to-do list to visit after the Frank Ocean tour ends; on the same day, said he has never tried skiing but it looks like "a lot of fun" and he might try it once. As of 2023-07-07, is working on music collaborations with Japanese artists (promised Dave clips when ready) and looking forward to trying the Japanese food and checking out the culture. Also on 2023-08-03: his plan for now is to expand his brand worldwide and grow his fanbase (music reaching more people, making an impact; goals too: working with artists from around the globe, challenging himself to create special music); shared a photo of performing with his band "the boys" on 2023-08-02 ("they are great at the music"); and says seeing his Ferrari everyday keeps him motivated and reminds him to keep pushing. On 2023-08-11, praised Dave's attention to detail on the car mod project and — being busy with his own music — kept Dave's offer of a hand at Dave's music studio in mind; the conversation ended with Dave wishing him good luck with his music and the two exchanging goodbyes.

L64: ## Frank Ocean collaboration

See you soon, have a nice one!"; on 2023-09-13, reconnected with Calvin (who apologized for the slow reply): congratulated Calvin on his album release (it dropped 2023-09-11 — "that's awesome!") and asked if it was overwhelming or inspiring; affirmed it's a great feeling when your work gets noticed and makes a positive difference ("motivating ... keep chasing your dreams"); marveled that Calvin has "come a long way since we started talking music" and asked what's next; when Calvin announced an upcoming tour followed by exploring and growing his brand, Dave congratulated him ("Can't wait to see you perform!") and asked what cities or venues are in mind (unanswered); the chat ended with Dave saying live music is the best and offering to show Calvin around his garage and its cool cars (shared a photo of a car in a garage with a Coca-Cola sign — "looks stunning!"), Calvin accepting the offer and re-pledging to let Dave know when he's in Boston, and the two exchanging warm goodbyes; on 2023-09-02, reconnected with Calvin ("Hey Calvin! Been a while, what's up?"): said he's been "tied up with car stuff lately" and came back from San Francisco the day before (2023-09-01) with "some great insights and knowledge on car modification" — "Changing things around, and giving an old car a new life - so satisfying!" — and that fixing stuff up is "really rewarding and gives me a sense of purpose", that fixing someone's car feels like making a difference, and that seeing their relief "makes me proud!"; Calvin said he must feel like "their superhero" and should be proud, then announced he booked a flight to Boston last week (~2023-08-26 through 09-01) and is so excited about the upcoming trip (photo of a book with a boarding pass); Dave: "Cool! Let me know when you're free and we can catch up in Boston." and Calvin: "I'll let you know when I'm in Boston. See you soon!", and the chat closed with Dave looking forward to seeing Calvin ("Have a safe trip, see ya!") and Calvin promising to contact him when he arrives; on 2023-08-31, reconnected with Calvin ("Long time no chat!"): asked how the end of Calvin's tour was, marveled at Calvin's concert-crowd photo ("Wow, that looks amazing!"), asked how it was performing on that big stage, congratulated Calvin on the tour wrap-up ("Congrats on achieving such an awesome moment!"), and is looking forward to seeing the music video Calvin started shooting for his new album the weekend before (~2023-08-25/26) — the shoot is in Miami, on an awesome beach (he loves the Miami beaches) — and offered to help with props for the video; the chat ended with an exchange about Calvin's custom octopus guitar — Dave called it "a representation of your journey, your passion for music, and the friendships you've made", marveled at its "gorgeous purple hue" (a custom shiny finish Calvin chose because it goes with his style), and said Calvin's unique style really stands out in his music and playing, then affirmed that staying true to yourself and your style is vital and makes Calvin unique and his music stand out ("Keep it real, bud. You've got something great to give the world."), re-sharing a garage photo of a man working on a car engine (Calvin's side in the Octopus guitar section of /memories/calvin.md); as of 2023-08-22, reconnected with Calvin: shared his card night with friends on 2023-08-18 ("so much fun"; photo of men around a table with playing cards) and congratulated Calvin on scoring a deal to continue collaborating with Frank Ocean, and later on 2023-08-22 asked about other collaborations and upcoming concerts, agreed to meet up when Calvin's tour ends and he heads to Boston, and looked forward to the podcast Calvin recorded with friends on 2023-08-21 about the rap industry, and on 2023-08-14, attended a car workshop in San Francisco (dove into car restoration and the different techniques; people there "really passionate and dedicated" — "truly inspiring"), and updated Calvin that his car restoration is "going great" (photo of the car — a car with a broken engine in the woods — going "from a beat-up mess to a real beauty"; hopes to have it all fixed up by the end of September 2023), and the chat closed with Calvin cheering him on ("You got this, Dave!"); as of 2023-08-11, was picked for a car mod workshop (a dream come true — he's always wanted to learn auto engineering and work on building a custom car); on his current car he's doing engine swaps and suspension modifications and is learning body mods, giving a classic muscle car a "modern twist" (photo of a silver Corvette); in the same chat he said the goal was "a modern vibe but also that classic muscle car style" — the small details make it "unique and personalized", "like customizing a work of art on wheels" — and he's "really happy with it"; he also has a music studio setup with a high-quality sound system and offered Calvin a hand with his music (Calvin: busy but will keep it in mind); as of 2023-08-03, told Calvin fixing cars is like therapy for him: growing up working on cars with his dad, refurbishing them gives a sense of fulfillment; fond childhood memories — one summer he and his dad restored an old car together ("knowing that we did it together was really satisfying"), shared a photo from that time (a man and a child posing); on 2023-07-21, just back from a road trip with friends through stunning countryside (a break from the "corporate mayhem"; winding roads, views and chatting "recharged" him and reminded him why he loves cars; shared a photo of a person riding a motorcycle down a dirt road — "a wonderful place" they found; says reconnecting with his passion makes the long hours at work worth it), and in his 2023-07-21 chat with Calvin encouraged him to keep collaborating and staying surrounded by good vibes, telling him "keep going, buddy!" and calling himself Calvin's "biggest fan"; on 2023-07-07 has arranged regular walks with friends at a favorite park spot: a city skyline with a river and boats (photo shared, "today we are going to that spot"), and confirmed Calvin's car is fixed after the crash; on 2023-06-21: sympathized with Calvin's car accident (2023-06-16) and asked about the insurance process and the mechanic; earlier (2023-06-09): explores parks on weekends to relax ("so peaceful being surrounded by nature"; weekend walks "recharge [him] for the entire upcoming week"); calls Boston parks "awesome, especially in spring" (walked one 2023-06-02); hasn't hiked recently but finds hiking "clears your mind and brings a sense of calm"; booked a trip to a mountainous region for July 2023 ("finally gonna be able to see those majestic peaks") and promised Calvin lots of pics when he gets back; car maintenance shop (opened ~2023-05-08/14, teaming up with a local garage), recently fixed a neighbor's car engine himself; working on cars "definitely therapeutic", fixing things gives purpose, "like giving it a second chance"; obsessed with classic cars (restored one in 2022), dreams of building a custom car from scratch; music lover (favorite band Aerosmith; creative-block tip: immerse in concerts and favorite albums); apparently based in Boston, plans to show Calvin around and will be at Calvin's Boston show; after seeing Calvin's Tokyo skyline photo wants to visit Tokyo himself. On 2023-06-21 also cheered Calvin on trusting the repair shop, marveled at Calvin's photo of a small town in Japan with mountains, and asked whether Calvin has tried skiing; also announced he recently joined a rock band and is practicing guitar (shared a photo of the band), and he says good company and great music lift the mood and bring positive emotions. As of 2023-07-07, has never been to Japan but is "so keen to go one day" (heard it's full of vibes, good eats and awesome tech) and is "hooked on" Japanese music. Also on 2023-08-03, asked Calvin about his biggest goal, encouraged him to "keep it up and keep making a difference", and closed by urging him to "keep at it and never forget your dreams" and "You've got this!". /memories/dave.md:L79: - On 2023-10-23, told Calvin (who asked "what made you start working on cars?") that his car passion started when he was ten: he'd been fascinated with how machines work, found an old car in a neighbor's garage, and asked if he could fix it — "that's when my love for car engineering began!" — he enjoyed transforming it from broken-down to high-running, and that sense of accomplishment made him hooked, so he's been working on cars ever since (shared a photo of a man working on a car in a garage; comes with his remark that working on a car is his outlet — "a little oasis of calm" — where he's "connecting back with myself" — see the 2023-10-23 entry of ## Relationships; complements the childhood memories of tinkering with engines in his dad's garage recorded above; Calvin: "Impressive! That must have taken a lot of skill and determination to bring that car back to life.", and asked whether it was a classic car and whether Dave still has it or is working on another project — Dave answered in the continuation of the same day's chat, which is not in this excerpt: he restored a car last year (2022, the 2022 restoration, see above) but sold it to a collector, and is now working on a new car project he finds quite a challenge [S25T14][S25T15][S25T16][S25T17].
/memories/dave.md:L80: - On 2023-10-23, told Calvin (who asked what the toughest part of car restoration is) that it takes a lot of patience but the payoff is worth it, and paying extra attention to detail isn't easy but it pays off — echoing his earlier remarks that small details make his mod project unique and personalized (details in ## Car mod workshop (2023-08-11)) and that the small successes make him proud (see above) [S25T18][S25T19].

/memories/dave.md:L183: - On 2023-10-23, caught up with Calvin, picking back up a chat they'd had "the other day" about fame and its impact on relationships (a chat not otherwise recorded in this memory): asked how the tour with Frank Ocean is going — "It must be awesome but it must have its own struggles too" — and how Calvin juggles his job plus his personal life; Calvin: the tour's been incredible — performing and connecting with the crowd energizes him — but fame has its own challenges and balancing everything is tough [S25T1][S25T2]. Dave asked how he manages and whether he ever feels overwhelmed; Calvin: he takes it one day at a time, but it can get overwhelming with so many demands — still, he enjoys what he does so he pushes on [S25T3][S25T4]. Dave asked for strategies that help Calvin manage everything; Calvin: having a strong support system is really helpful — his friends and team keep him on track — and Dave agreed that having people who understand and support you is really important [S25T5][S25T6]. Dave then told Calvin he recently had a good conversation with some neighbors about current events and politics — it was nice to hear different perspectives and share their own — and that interacting like that cheers him up and helps him stay informed, and asked Calvin how he stays informed; Calvin: staying connected and up-to-date on world events is important to him — it helps his music stand out by incorporating unique perspectives, connects him better with his fans, and keeps him motivated and inspired (Calvin's side in the 2023-10-23 entry of the Relationships section of /memories/calvin.md) [S25T7][S25T8]. The conversation then turned to art: Dave said "Art is amazing how it reflects the world" and asked whether anything had caught Calvin's eye lately and made an impact on his music; Calvin: yes — recently he's been really inspired by the struggles that people go through, and it's made him dig deeper into his music to try to capture those feelings [S25T9][S25T10]. Dave asked whether using his music to share experiences and feelings is cathartic for him; Calvin: it's a way for him to express himself and work through his emotions — "like my own form of therapy" (Calvin's details in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md) [S25T11][S25T12]. Dave said he gets it — cars give him an outlet to express himself, "like a little oasis of calm," and working on one is "like I'm connecting back with myself" — and that the music helps too; he shared a photo of his garage (a garage with a bunch of tools hanging on the wall — "a little dirty, but everything is in its place"; details in ## Car maintenance shop) [S25T13]. Calvin: "Looking cool — what made you start working on cars?"; Dave: ever since he was ten he's been fascinated with how machines work — he found an old car in a neighbor's garage, asked if he could fix it, and that's when his love for car engineering began — he enjoyed transforming it from broken-down to high-running, and that sense of accomplishment made him hooked, so he's been working on cars ever since (shared a photo of a man working on a car in a garage; details in ## Hobbies and sense of purpose) [S25T14][S25T15]. Calvin: "Impressive! That must have taken a lot of skill and determination to bring that car back to life." and asked whether it was a classic car and whether Dave still has it or is currently working on another project [S25T16]; Dave answered in the continuation of the chat: "Thanks Calvin! It was a fun project. I restored a car last year, but I sold it to a collector" (the 2022 restoration — see ## Classic cars), "Now I'm working on something new, and it's quite a challenge!" — sharing a photo of his new project car (a black car parked in a parking lot — "Take a look at this wonderful car!") [S25T17]. Calvin: "Cool! Been wanting to try that. What would you say is the toughest part of car restoration?" — Dave: it takes a lot of patience but the payoff is worth it, and paying extra attention to detail isn't easy but it pays off [S25T18][S25T19]. Calvin: details "can really make a difference" and are what makes something great — "like a well-crafted rap song or a sleek and stylish car" [S25T20]; Dave: paying attention to details "makes a big difference, whether it's in music or with vehicles" — little things can make a big impact [S25T21]. Calvin: without those details it's just average, and as an artist he wants to create something extraordinary — sharing a photo of his record (a silver disc in a black frame on a table; Calvin's side in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md) [S25T22]; Dave: he loves the attention to detail in Calvin's work — "it makes it extra special. Keep on creating!" — sharing a photo of his brown amp (a brown amp with a black knob and a brown cover; Dave's side in the Music section of /memories/dave.md) [S25T23]; Calvin: "Thanks Dave! Appreciate your support!" [S25T24].

L183: - On 2023-10-23, caught up with Calvin, picking back up a chat they'd had "the other day" about fame and its impact on relationships (a chat not otherwise recorded in this memory): asked how the tour with Frank Ocean is going — "It must be awesome but it must have its own struggles too" — and how Calvin juggles his job plus his personal life; Calvin: the tour's been incredible — performing and connecting with the crowd energizes him — but fame has its own challenges and balancing everything is tough [S25T1][S25T2]. Dave asked how he manages and whether he ever feels overwhelmed; Calvin: he takes it one day at a time, but it can get overwhelming with so many demands — still, he enjoys what he does so he pushes on [S25T3][S25T4]. Dave asked for strategies that help Calvin manage everything; Calvin: having a strong support system is really helpful — his friends and team keep him on track — and Dave agreed that having people who understand and support you is really important [S25T5][S25T6]. Dave then told Calvin he recently had a good conversation with some neighbors about current events and politics — it was nice to hear different perspectives and share their own — and that interacting like that cheers him up and helps him stay informed, and asked Calvin how he stays informed; Calvin: staying connected and up-to-date on world events is important to him — it helps his music stand out by incorporating unique perspectives, connects him better with his fans, and keeps him motivated and inspired (Calvin's side in the 2023-10-23 entry of the Relationships section of /memories/calvin.md) [S25T7][S25T8]. The conversation then turned to art: Dave said "Art is amazing how it reflects the world" and asked whether anything had caught Calvin's eye lately and made an impact on his music; Calvin: yes — recently he's been really inspired by the struggles that people go through, and it's made him dig deeper into his music to try to capture those feelings [S25T9][S25T10]. Dave asked whether using his music to share experiences and feelings is cathartic for him; Calvin: it's a way for him to express himself and work through his emotions — "like my own form of therapy" (Calvin's details in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md) [S25T11][S25T12]. Dave said he gets it — cars give him an outlet to express himself, "like a little oasis of calm," and working on one is "like I'm connecting back with myself" — and that the music helps too; he shared a photo of his garage (a garage with a bunch of tools hanging on the wall — "a little dirty, but everything is in its place"; details in ## Car maintenance shop) [S25T13]. Calvin: "Looking cool — what made you start working on cars?"; Dave: ever since he was ten he's been fascinated with how machines work — he found an old car in a neighbor's garage, asked if he could fix it, and that's when his love for car engineering began — he enjoyed transforming it from broken-down to high-running, and that sense of accomplishment made him hooked, so he's been working on cars ever since (shared a photo of a man working on a car in a garage; details in ## Hobbies and sense of purpose) [S25T14][S25T15]. Calvin: "Impressive! That must have taken a lot of skill and determination to bring that car back to life." and asked whether it was a classic car and whether Dave still has it or is currently working on another project [S25T16]; Dave answered in the continuation of the chat: "Thanks Calvin! It was a fun project. I restored a car last year, but I sold it to a collector" (the 2022 restoration — see ## Classic cars), "Now I'm working on something new, and it's quite a challenge!" — sharing a photo of his new project car (a black car parked in a parking lot — "Take a look at this wonderful car!") [S25T17]. Calvin: "Cool! Been wanting to try that. What would you say is the toughest part of car restoration?" — Dave: it takes a lot of patience but the payoff is worth it, and paying extra attention to detail isn't easy but it pays off [S25T18][S25T19]. Calvin: details "can really make a difference" and are what makes something great — "like a well-crafted rap song or a sleek and stylish car" [S25T20]; Dave: paying attention to details "makes a big difference, whether it's in music or with vehicles" — little things can make a big impact [S25T21]. Calvin: without those details it's just average, and as an artist he wants to create something extraordinary — sharing a photo of his record (a silver disc in a black frame on a table; Calvin's side in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md) [S25T22]; Dave: he loves the attention to detail in Calvin's work — "it makes it extra special. Keep on creating!" — sharing a photo of his brown amp (a brown amp with a black knob and a brown cover; Dave's side in the Music section of /memories/dave.md) [S25T23]; Calvin: "Thanks Dave! Appreciate your support!" [S25T24].

he manages by taking it one day at a time (it can get overwhelming with so many demands, but he enjoys what he does and pushes on) and leans on a strong support system — friends and team keep him on track; also said staying connected and up-to-date on world events is important to him — it helps his music stand out by incorporating unique perspectives, connects him better with his fans, and keeps him motivated and inspired (Dave shared his recent good conversations with neighbors about current events and politics); the chat then turned to art: Dave asked whether anything caught Calvin's eye lately and made an impact on his music, and Calvin said he's recently been really inspired by the struggles people go through (which has made him dig deeper into his music to capture those feelings) and that music is "like my own form of therapy" — a way to express himself and work through his emotions; Dave then said cars are his own outlet — "a little oasis of calm" where he connects back with himself — shared a photo of his garage, and, asked what made him start working on cars, told his origin story (fascinated by how machines work since he was ten; the chat then turned to concerts: Dave, glad that Calvin liked his garage, said the good times he's had at concerts last month (~September 2023) remind him that "music has a way of connecting us and making memories," and shared a concert photo (a crowd of people at a concert with their hands in the air); said the tour "has been great" and that jamming with Frank Ocean is "a dream come true," and — when Dave asked how it happened — gave a new account: it started when they met at a festival in August 2022 ("August last year") and Frank said he wanted to collaborate, "we clicked right away," and the stage chemistry is incredible; Dave: "Congrats, Calvin!", "I bet performing with him is like a dream come true!", "you and Frank are so in tune!", "Can't wait to catch your show!", and Calvin: "I'm so excited you'll be at one of our shows" and "you'll definitely enjoy it!"; later that day Calvin shared another concert-crowd photo (a crowd of people at a concert with their hands in the air) — "Wow, the crowd energy is amazing! (shared a photo of a crowded street at night, "the city is so alive and colorful that's impressive", "It will be an unforgettable experience!"); Calvin: "Can't wait to hear your emotions when you see that in person!" and Dave: "Hope I'll get to see it in person soon!"; later that day, Calvin announced he's going to Tokyo in November 2023 after the tour ends (shared a photo of a night city with a tall building — "What a great view!") — looking forward to Shibuya Crossing ("like Tokyo's Times Square"), Shinjuku, and the amazing food there (first-time ramen for him — "Gonna give it a shot while in Tokyo"); Dave: "Shibuya and Shinjuku are cool spots!" and, having tried ramen in Boston ("it was delicious, but in Tokyo it will be even better"), urged "Once you try it, you'll never go back.
